summary: Search for a missing 7-year-old girl near County Road 108 and County Road 12 South in Alamosa County; AVSAR joined CSP, Alamosa Fire, Victim Advocates, and Sheriff Posse in line searches and house-to-house. Found safe and uninjured by a CSP trooper after residents reported small footprints and something purple near an outbuilding.
location: County Road 108 and County Road 12 South
notes: Girl wore a multi-colored coat and carried a purple backpack; similar prior incident noted.
